#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    
    cin >> n;
    cin >> s;
    
    int max = 0, count = 0, curr = 0;
    bool inside = false;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char ch = s[i];
        switch (ch) {
            case '_':
                if (inside && curr > 0) {
                    count++;
                    curr = 0;
                } else {
                    if (curr > max) max = curr;
                    curr = 0;
                }
                break;
            case '(':
                inside = true;
                if (curr > max) max = curr;
                curr = 0;
                break;
            case ')':
                inside = false;
                if (curr > 0) {
                    count++;
                    curr = 0;
                }
                break;
            default:
                curr++;
        }
    }
    if (curr > max) max = curr;
    
    cout << max << " " << count << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
